title: loukesio/mgviz pipeline parameters
description: Virus detection from metagenomic reads with an interactive d3 report

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

samplesheet.description: Samplesheet CSV with columns sample, fastq_1, fastq_2 (optional), type (optional).
samplesheet.help_text: Relative FASTQ paths are resolved against the samplesheet's directory. See docs/usage.md.

outdir.description: Output directory; the report is written to <outdir>/mgviz_report.html.

title.description: Title shown in the report's browser tab.

optional_steps.title: Optional steps
optional_steps.description: Host filtering, gene prediction and geNomad scoring.

filter_fasta.description: Host or spike-in FASTA; reads mapping to it are removed before virus detection.

genomad_db.description: geNomad database directory; enables virus scoring, hallmark genes and ICTV taxonomy per consensus.

genomad_splits.description: mmseqs2 database splits for geNomad; 8 keeps memory under 8 GB.

predict_proteins.description: Predict ORFs on every consensus genome with pyrodigal-gv.

alignment_options.title: Alignment and filtering
alignment_options.description: minimap2 settings and the alignment filters applied at every mapping step (EsViritu defaults).

min_read_cov.description: Minimum aligned fraction of the read.

min_read_len.description: Minimum read length kept by fastp.

share_thresh.description: Fraction of shared reads (of the smaller genome) that joins two references into one cluster.

sp_thresh.description: Consensus identity below which the species is reported as unclassified.

subsp_thresh.description: Consensus identity below which the subspecies is reported as unclassified.

container.description: Container image used by every process.

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix of the Nextflow run reports in pipeline_info.

standalone_module_inputs.title: Standalone module inputs
standalone_module_inputs.description: Only used when a single module is run on its own (nextflow run modules/local/<name>/main.nf).
